project_meta.title: What If AI Was Never Invented After 2022?

global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn stickman explainer, cinematic storytelling, warm off-white paper texture, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, limited earthy accent colors with muted blue for technology and warm orange for highlights. The recurring presenter has a perfectly round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes of identical size and spacing, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights, reflections or eyelashes, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie. Every other stickman character must use exactly the same two tiny solid-black dot eyes, with identical shape, size and spacing. Keep characters visually consistent throughout. Vertical 9:16 composition, expressive poses, clear visual storytelling, uncluttered backgrounds.
global_style.negative_prompt: No realistic human anatomy, no 3D rendering, no photorealism, no detailed facial features, no changing eye styles, no pupils, no irises, no eye whites, no eye highlights, no reflections, no eyelashes, no eyebrows covering eyes, no extra eyes, no text-heavy images, no watermarks, no logos, no cluttered compositions.

beats.narration_text: सोचो, अगर दो हज़ार बाईस के बाद एआई आम लोगों तक कभी पहुँचा ही नहीं होता?
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic hand-drawn illustration of the recurring presenter standing in front of a modern city, holding a glowing smartphone while a large floating AI symbol made of simple connected lines appears above the phone and then fades into a question mark. The presenter has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie. Warm off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, muted blue and orange accents, dramatic but uncluttered composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the presenter and city consistent. The AI symbol should be visually simple and recognizable without any readable text.

beats.narration_text: ना चैटजीपीटी, ना आम लोगों के लिए एआई इमेज और वीडियो टूल्स।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 close-up of the recurring stickman presenter looking at a smartphone showing three empty app-style panels: a blank chat bubble, an empty image frame and a blank video screen, each crossed out with a simple black line. The presenter has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a simple curved mouth and a small red bow tie. Minimalist hand-drawn black ink, warm paper texture, muted blue accents, no readable words or logos.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the phone and the three crossed-out empty panels clear and visually simple.

beats.narration_text: सबसे पहले, पढ़ाई का तरीका अलग होता। स्टूडेंट्स हर सवाल का जवाब तुरंत नहीं पूछ पाते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn scene of a young student sitting at a wooden study desk, surrounded by thick textbooks and handwritten notebooks, looking confused at a difficult question on paper. The student has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, and simple stick limbs. A laptop sits closed beside the books. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, muted earthy colors, expressive but simple pose.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the student, desk and textbooks consistent. Show the challenge through the pile of books and puzzled posture, not detailed facial features.

beats.narration_text: लोग किताबें पढ़ते, टीचर्स से पूछते और जवाब ढूँढने में ज़्यादा समय लगाते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 over-the-shoulder view of the same student reading an open textbook while a teacher stickman points toward a large chalkboard filled with simple diagrams and symbols. Both characters have round white faces with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes each, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections. Warm classroom setting, black ink outlines, muted green and ochre accents, no readable text.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Preserve the student's blue backpack and consistent simple dot eyes for both characters.

beats.narration_text: ऑफिस में ईमेल, रिपोर्ट और प्रेज़ेंटेशन बनाने का काम भी ज़्यादातर खुद करना पड़ता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn modern office scene with the office worker sitting at a desk, facing a computer monitor, surrounded by paper documents, printed charts and sticky notes. The worker has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, thin black stick limbs, muted green shirt and dark trousers. A wall clock shows time passing. Warm paper texture, bold black outlines, restrained colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the same office worker and office layout. Use paper piles and the clock to communicate repetitive work.

beats.narration_text: कई छोटे कामों में इंसानों का समय लगता, जिन्हें आज एआई कुछ ही सेकंड में शुरू कर देता है।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 top-down view of the same office worker's crowded desk, with a long checklist of simple task icons: email envelope, document page, chart and calendar. The worker's hands are busy sorting papers and typing on a keyboard. The worker's round white face is partially visible with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections. Hand-drawn ink style, warm paper texture, muted blue and orange accents, no readable words.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show multiple small tasks competing for attention without adding extra characters or changing the worker's design.

beats.narration_text: छोटे बिज़नेस वालों के लिए भी विज्ञापन, डिज़ाइन और नए आइडिया बनाना मुश्किल और महँगा रहता।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 scene inside a modest neighborhood shop. The small business owner stands behind the counter, looking at a plain empty promotional poster, a basic camera and scattered paper sketches. The owner has a round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, thin stick limbs and a mustard apron. Shelves of ordinary products in the background, warm off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, muted earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the shop owner, counter and shelves consistent. The blank poster should suggest a lack of affordable design resources.

beats.narration_text: आज वही इंसान कम बजट में भी डिज़ाइन, आइडिया और कंटेंट तैयार कर सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 hand-drawn scene of the same small business owner confidently using a laptop on the shop counter. Floating around the laptop are three simple visual results: a neat product poster, a lightbulb idea icon and a short video frame, all represented without readable text. The owner has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a round white face and mustard apron. Warm paper texture, black ink outlines, muted blue and orange accents.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the same shop owner now looking productive, with simple visual examples of affordable creative work.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन दुनिया रुकती नहीं। लोग फिर भी इंटरनेट पर खोजते, पुराने सॉफ्टवेयर इस्तेमाल करते और इंसानों से मदद लेते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 wide hand-drawn city composition showing everyday people using traditional tools: a student searching through books, an office worker typing into a conventional software interface, and a person asking a colleague for help. All stickman characters have round white faces with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, muted earthy colors, clear separated visual groups.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a functioning world that is less automated, not a ruined or technologically primitive world.

beats.narration_text: शायद काम थोड़ा धीमा होता, लेकिन इंसान सीखना और नई चीज़ें बनाना बंद नहीं करते।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 uplifting hand-drawn scene of the recurring presenter standing beside a group of ordinary stickman people building something together: one sketches an idea, another types on a laptop, and another assembles a small prototype. Every character has exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections. The presenter has a red bow tie. Warm golden light, off-white paper texture, bold imperfect black ink outlines, restrained earthy colors.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the presenter recognizable and show collaboration, creativity and human problem-solving.

beats.narration_text: तो एआई के बिना दुनिया शायद धीमी होती, लेकिन क्या वो बेहतर होती? ये तो इस बात पर निर्भर करता कि हम एआई का इस्तेमाल कैसे करते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Vertical 9:16 cinematic final composition. The recurring presenter stands in the center holding a smartphone in one hand and a small glowing lightbulb in the other. Behind the presenter, one side shows people collaborating without AI and the other side shows people using AI tools thoughtfully. The presenter has a perfectly round white face with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, no pupils, irises, eye whites, highlights or reflections, a simple curved mouth, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie. Warm off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, balanced muted blue and orange accents, thoughtful hopeful atmosphere, no readable text.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End on a balanced visual contrast between human creativity and AI assistance. Preserve the presenter's exact dot-eye design.
